---
title: "Contact Me"
---

```{=html}
<div class="row g-5 mt-2">

  <!-- Left column -->
  <div class="col-md-5">
    <p>Feel free to get in touch for any inquiries or opportunities. I am open to collaborations, scientific projects, and job opportunities where I can contribute my expertise in remote sensing, LiDAR, and environmental data science.</p>
    <p class="mt-4"><i class="bi bi-envelope me-2"></i><a href="mailto:dingjinchu@gmail.com">dingjinchu@gmail.com</a></p>
    <p><i class="bi bi-geo-alt me-2"></i>Agricultural Hall, Department of Natural Resource Ecology &amp; Management, Oklahoma State University, Stillwater, OK</p>
    <div class="d-flex gap-2 mt-3">
      <a href="mailto:dingjinchu@gmail.com" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" title="Email"><i class="bi bi-envelope-fill"></i></a>
      <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dingjin-chu-892ba7352/" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" title="LinkedIn"><i class="bi bi-linkedin"></i></a>
      <a href="https://github.com/Programmer112321" target="_blank" class="btn btn-dark btn-sm" title="GitHub"><i class="bi bi-github"></i></a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Right column -->
  <div class="col-md-7">
    <form id="contactForm" onsubmit="submitContact(event)">
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label">Full Name <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="c-name" class="form-control" required>
      </div>
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label">Email <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
        <input type="email" id="c-email" class="form-control" required>
      </div>
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label">Affiliation <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="c-affiliation" class="form-control" required>
      </div>
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label">Position <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="c-position" class="form-control" required>
      </div>
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label">Message <span class="text-danger">*</span></label>
        <textarea id="c-message" class="form-control" rows="5" placeholder="Enter your message" required></textarea>
      </div>
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary px-4">Submit</button>
    </form>
    <script>
    function submitContact(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var name        = document.getElementById('c-name').value;
      var email       = document.getElementById('c-email').value;
      var affiliation = document.getElementById('c-affiliation').value;
      var position    = document.getElementById('c-position').value;
      var message     = document.getElementById('c-message').value;
      var subject     = encodeURIComponent('Message from ' + name);
      var body        = encodeURIComponent(
        'Name: ' + name + '\r\n' +
        'Email: ' + email + '\r\n' +
        'Affiliation: ' + affiliation + '\r\n' +
        'Position: ' + position + '\r\n\r\n' +
        'Message:\r\n' + message
      );
      window.location.href = 'mailto:dingjinchu@gmail.com?subject=' + subject + '&body=' + body;
    }
    </script>
  </div>

</div>
```
